messages.subject_clean: Thanks for creating a great package!
messages.body_plain:
Hi group, I wanted to share a blog post I wrote about MPlusAutomation: https://jrosen48.github.io/blog/using-mplus-from-r/, in the off-chance that any of what is discussed in it is helpful to future list members.

Thanks, Michael and Josh, for creating a great package!

- Josh
